 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE HARISH KUMAR  ORAL ORDER 2 12-08-2024 Heard Mr. Satyendra Rai, learned Advocate for the petitioner and Mr. Sriram Krishna, learned Advocate for NHAI.
Mr. Arif Daula Siddiqui, learned Advocate for the State is also present.

2. The petitioner by invoking the extraordinary jurisdiction of this Court under Article 226 of the Constitution of India seeks a direction upon the respondent authorities to ensure the computation of compensation amount of his land Patna High Court CWJC No.12010 of 2024(2) dt.12-08-2024 under the commercial rate in place of agricultural rate as calculated vide notice dated 13.03.2024.

sentences.text:
3. Learned Advocate for the respective parties fairly contended that the land in question was acquired in pursuant to Land Acquisition Case No.28 of 2023-2024 for construction of Ramjanaki Path Pariyojana NH-227A.
4.

Admittedly the petitioner has efficacious statutory remedy under Section 3G(5) of the National Highways Act, 1956 wherein the Divisional Commissioner, Saran has made arbitrator under the notification issued by the Union of India.

5. In view of the aforesaid facts and taking note of the grievance raised before this Court, the present writ petition stands disposed off with a liberty to the petitioner to approach before the learned Arbitrator in terms of Section 3G(5) of the National Highways Act, 1956.
6. The writ petition stands disposed off with the liberty aforesaid.

(Harish Kumar, J) durgesh/-
